description: Audit a domain's DNS against what Microsoft 365 expects: SPF includes spf.protection.outlook.com, DKIM selector1/selector2 (CNAME target and key), DMARC policy and rua=, MX to Microsoft 365 (*.mail.protection.outlook.com or *.mx.microsoft), MTA-STS, Autodiscover to autodiscover.outlook.com, TLS-RPT, BIMI, and the Teams SIP SRV records. Built from the same envelopes check_spf, check_dkim, check_dmarc, check_mx, check_mta_sts, check_tls_rpt and check_bimi return, so it never disagrees with them. `verdict` is configured / configured_with_issues / not_detected / unknown (no indicator found Microsoft 365 and at least one did not answer). A domain with no Microsoft 365 indicator returns only M365_NOT_DETECTED (status info). A check that could not run is listed in M365_CHECK_INCOMPLETE and its `analysis.checks[]` entry is `unknown`, never "missing". Findings include M365_SPF_NO_O365_INCLUDE, M365_SPF_INVALID, M365_DKIM_SELECTOR_MISSING, M365_DKIM_NO_KEY_AT_CNAME, M365_DKIM_CNAME_MISMATCH, M365_DMARC_MISSING, M365_DMARC_NOT_ENFORCING, M365_MX_NOT_M365, M365_MTA_STS_MISSING, M365_AUTODISCOVER_MISSING, M365_TLS_RPT_MISSING_UNDER_ENFORCE and more (registry: resources/read mcp://tamingdns/resources/finding-codes). Read-only.

domain.description: Apex domain to inspect, e.g. "google.com". No scheme, no path.

name: check_m365

analysis.description: Tool-specific detail; its fields are typed in the resource mcp://tamingdns/resources/analysis/<tool name>.
